observations.why: First-person plural adoption declaration enacts collective authority — 'we' decides for the whole, not a proposal seeking ratification.
Proportionality framing — performance gain quantified as a multiplier, the cost/benefit case for the decision.
Commissive timeline set by the same speaker who declared the adoption — rank enacted through scheduling commitment.
Summary recapitulates the proportionality case as a bullet-pointed metric, reinforcing cost/benefit framing.
